rendered: In the BatPaC scenario (For 1,000,000 EVs with 260 miles drive range[1]), the text gives these cobalt requirements. The mainstream NMC 111[2] cathode (33.3%[3] Co) would need ≈2500 tons[4] of cobalt. The next-generation cathodes, NMC 811[5] and NCA, would still require ≈700 tons of cobalt[6] to realize this scenario. For NFA, the document says that no cobalt would be required[7], and the NFA bar in Fig. 1[8] shows no cobalt segment.
